events.verdict: Murray-Boyles (TOR) jumps vertically on his contest and absorbs the incidental contact from Harden (LAC) as Harden drifts forward after releasing the driving shot attempt.
The replay center confirms the call on the court that Murray-Boyles (TOR) makes contact with the ball after it has reached its apex and is on its downward trajectory toward the rim.
Harden (LAC) makes clean contact with the ball to dislodge it from Murray-Boyles (TOR) during the post-shot attempt.
After being cleanly dislodged, the ball ricochets off Murray- Boyles' (TOR) forearm and goes out of bounds, Possession is correctly awarded to the Clippers.
Agbaji (TOR) initiates contact with Harden's (LAC) left arm after bringing his right hand underneath to the ball to gather, and affects his driving shot attempt.
Dunn (LAC) makes legal hand-on-ball contact during his steal attempt at the end of Ingram's (TOR) drive.
Zubac (LAC) maintains a legal guarding position and absorbs the incidental contact he defends Agbaji's (TOR) shot attempt.
Miller (LAC) makes clean contact with the ball on his dislodge attempt during Agbaji's (TOR) driving shot attempt.

Replay review of the foul called on Dunn (LAC) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Dunn goes not gives Barnes (TOR) the time or distance to change directions and avoid the contact during the pick.
Barnes (TOR) is already in Sanders' (LAC) path when marginal contact occurs during the screen.
Harden (LAC) brushes Ingram's (TOR) arm as he makes his intended pass, and the contact is marginal.
Miller (LAC) legally contests Agbaji's (TOR) jump shot attempt.
Barnes (TOR) momentarily rests his hand on Zubac's (LAC) shoulder and marginal contact occurs as Zubac taps the loose ball to his teammate.
Barnes (TOR) maintains a legal guarding position as he defends Harden (LAC) during the drive.
Barnes (TOR) legally contests Harden's (LAC) jump shot attempt.
Sanders (LAC) grasps Ingram's (TOR) jersey and marginal contact occurs during the pursuit of the rebound.
The officials conference and assess a jump ball due to uncertainty on who touches the ball last before it goes out of bounds between Ingram (TOR) and Sanders (LAC).
Harden (LAC) engages with Shead (TOR) off-ball and marginal contact occurs as Harden releases away to retrieve the pass.
Murray-Boyles (TOR) is in the paint for at or about three seconds when he is imminently exiting.
Shead (TOR) retreats his arms into a vertical position and makes marginal contact while contesting Harden's (LAC) shot attempt.
Harden (LAC) initiates contact with Barnes' (TOR) arm, which affects his play at the basket.
Prior to the timeout, Harden (LAC) pushes his dribble ahead as he moves between two defenders and no illegal contact occurs from either Ingram (TOR) or Barnes (TOR).
Barnes (TOR) legally contests Harden's (LAC) jump shot attempt.
Zubac (LAC) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to the Raptors.
Harden (LAC) legally contests Barnes' (TOR) jump shot attempt.
Harden (LAC) brings his left hand to Murray-Boyles' (TOR) front and marginal contact occurs as Harden releases away during the drive.
Murray-Boyles (TOR) legally contests Harden's (LAC) jump shot attempt.
Harden (LAC) legally contests Barnes' (TOR) driving shot attempt.
Harden (LAC) goes to, not through, Barnes' (TOR) space and marginal contact occurs as Harden releases away during the drive.
Barnes (TOR) legally contests Harden's (LAC) jump shot attempt.
Sanders (LAC) rests his left hand on Ingram's (TOR) body during the jump shot attempt, and the contact is marginal.
Barnes (TOR) commits a take foul on Dunn (LAC).
Sanders (LAC) momentarily fumbles the ball on his own and there is no illegal contact by Ingram (TOR).
There is no clear or conclusive video evidence to overturn the call on the court of Murray-Boyles (TOR) touching the ball last before going out of bounds.
Agbaji (TOR) brings his hand toward the ball and marginal contact occurs with Harden's (LAC) arm as Harden start his dribble up the court.
Ingram (TOR) commits a take foul on Sanders (LAC).
Barnes (TOR) takes more than 5 seconds to release the throw-in.
After mutually engaging, Ingram (TOR) grasps and quickly releases Dunn's (LAC) arm off-ball and the contact is marginal.
Miller (LAC) legally contests Shead's (TOR) jump shot attempt.
Shead (TOR) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to the Clippers.
